verses.text: For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.

verses.text: The LORD looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.

segments.text: The LORD looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.

verses.text: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

segments.text: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

verses.text: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.

segments.text: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.

verses.text: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is in the company of the righteous.

segments.text: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is in the company of the righteous.

verses.text: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.

segments.text: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.

verses.text: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!

segments.text: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
